mods.name: Saved Commands
mods.description: This mod lets you save commands and chat messages for easier access later using keyboard shortcuts and the saved commands menu.

releases.notes:
Port to Minecraft 26.3!
- Changed configuration to use input API independent friendly names (migration happens automatically).
- Soft-lock prevention when setting left click as keybind.
- Minor bug fixes regarding inputs and ":" in file name handling.
Please note that some keybinds might need to be reconfigured as the configuration changed and Mojang now uses a different API for inputs (Switch from GLFW to SDL3).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Pr77Pr77/savedcommands/compare/1.3.2-beta+26.2.x...1.3.3-beta+26.3.x
